name: 5th Workshop on UK Digital Economics
organizer: UK Researcher-Practitioner Network for the Economics of Digitization; hosted by Bennett School of Public Policy (Cambridge); sponsored by Centre for Competition Policy (UEA) and Brian Kahin
venue: McGrath Centre, St Catharine's College, Cambridge CB2 1DS
submission_requirements: Submit via Microsoft Office Form; extended abstracts considered but complete papers more likely to be accepted; PhD students and junior scholars especially encouraged
registration_fee: Speakers exempt from registration fees; participants pay own travel and accommodation
